sentences.text: Yes, the product note is consistent with the applicable RBI direction for a UCB because for all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges.
The bank’s product note says that for individual borrowers on floating rate loans for non-business purposes, no foreclosure charge applies.
The bank’s key facts statement also shows pre-payment / foreclosure charges as nil.
The older RBI pre-payment-charge directions are superseded, while the in-force UCB directions apply to loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026.
